evidence: Al2O3 material was deposited on the MWNTs at a temperature of 300/C14C with ALD technique. Trimethylaluminum (TMA) and distilled water (H2O) were utilized as the precursors for the Al2O3 deposition. The process pressure was 250 and 230mTorr for the dosing of chemical precursors and the Ar purging, respectively.
